messages:
maria (growth): quick pulse: we need a very short benchmark narrative for the launch landing + one social card. core ask: concise latency vs $/1k story + clear CTA routing. who can own micro-deck + copy?
tejas (marketing): i'll own copy and the A/B experiment wiring. keep visuals 1-2 panels so social images are consistent.
olivia (design): propose one stacked card: left = p50/p95 sparkline by token length, right = cost-per-1k bars (hosted vs dedicated quant). mobile: show only the cost bars.
samir (pm): data source: use v2-opt baseline + quantized dedicated runs. i'll export a trimmed CSV with seq_len, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_hosted, cost_ded_quant and drop into /bench/launch/mini.csv. include cold/warm tag.
nina (content): hero line options: A) "Fast p50s. Predictable per-token costs." B) "Ship low-latency inference and cut unit cost." CTAs to test: "Start free" vs "Estimate savings".
maria (growth): routing rule: if estimated monthly tokens >100k OR first-week tokens >25k then route to AE. Ben, can partners page include a referral path?
ben (partners): yup, add UTM + hidden field for partner id. we'll surface high-usage leads weekly.
tejas (marketing): experiment plan: 2-week A/B, measure CTR -> signup -> token volume. dashboard owners: tejas + ben.
olivia (design): placeholder numbers for layout heatmap/bar:
```
seq_len,p50,p95,cost_hosted,cost_ded_quant
128,45,120,0.020,0.0055
512,82,230,0.020,0.0060
1024,210,620,0.020,0.0075
```
use those for spacing.
samir (pm): CSV link: /bench/launch/mini.csv. note: dedicated cost varies with batch; include footnote in the design.
nina (content): i'll draft hero + 3 social caption variants and drop them in the doc by EOD. tone: technical but punchy.
maria (growth): timeline: design mock Thu, copy Fri, internal review Mon, experiment Wed. owners: olivia design, nina copy, samir data, tejas experiment, maria launch. quick 15m sign-off Mon morning.
tejas (marketing): will set up experiment and a short success metric doc. thanks team :rocket:
